sources.observation: Customers add credits through the Cloud console.
NEAR AI officially announced crypto payments through HOT Pay. This does not specify unattended checkout or organization binding.
Reviewed billing-related customer paths describe inference costs, organization balance and staking source/sync. A customer purchase/checkout path was not found in this specification.
The Cloud API places checkout and credit recalculation in a separate billing UI/service.
Merchant payment links and merchant-authenticated processed-payment queries are documented. NEAR AI organization-to-credit mapping was not found.
GET /partners/processed_payments requires a partner token. Being a NEAR AI customer does not grant its merchant token.

inference: The inspected interfaces do not yet establish a supported unattended NEAR AI customer purchase flow. A provider-issued checkout may help verify the missing binding; this is not a claim that all possible integrations are absent.
